name: Yu Wen
source:
A love story in a faraway land, choose between the childhood sweetheart or the sudden heartthrob to be our protagonist's eternity.

The protagonist, Karl the snow leopard, was haunted by the cold. He would lift his curse with the help of Radle, the brown bear, who he has known for a long time, and Alex, the black dragon, a mysterious prince from other countries, Karl embarked on a journey to lift his curse.

[Edited from [url=https://h-dali.itch.io/warmsolace]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一段异国情调的爱情故事，青梅竹马还是一夜情人之间的选择，成为主角的永恒。

主角雪豹卡尔被寒冷所困扰。他要解除诅咒，在相识已久的棕熊拉德尔和来自异国的神秘王子黑龙亚历克斯的帮助下，卡尔踏上了解除诅咒的旅程。

[编辑自[url=https://h-dali.itch.io/warmsolace]Itch.io[/url]]
